data.name: Jalila
data.gender_notes: Jalila is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jalil', meaning 'noble, nobleman, exalted'. The feminine form is 'Jalila'. The name Jalila carries the meaning “Noble and Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jalila usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jalila is a name that represents inner beauty and grace. It is a reminder to strive for excellence and to let your light shine brightly.
data.etymology: Jalila belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble and Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jalila total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: جَلِيلَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اِسم الجَليلَةُ من أسماء النُسخ العَرَبِيَة، يَنحدر هذا الاسم من الجَليل، وَهُوَ مُشترك بين الفاعلين الجَليلُ والجَليلَةُ، يَنصرف الجَليلُ إلى المُفاجئ المُستغرب، وَيَنصرف الجَليلَةُ إلى العظمى الحازمة والقوية، وَتَختم الجَليلَةُ المُستحسنة في العُصور الجاهِلِيَة، وَالسُلَفِيَة، وَهِيَ مُستخدمة في عُصور مُختلفة، مِنها السُيَر العَرَبِيَة، والتَصَويرات الفُنّيَة، وَهِيَ تَساعد على اِستحسانه في حياته المُستقبلة

in_urdu.name: جَلِیلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام کا تعلق جَلیل سے ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عجیب، غریب، مستحسن، اور جَلیلہ سے ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بڑی، عظیم، قوی، اور مستحسنی، جو عربی زبان میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس سے مراد عظیم ترین خاتون، بڑی، قوی، اور مستحسنی خاتون ہوتی ہے، جو اسلام کے پیروکاروں میں مقبول ہے

in_english.name: Jalila
in_english.meaning: Jalila is a name of greatness, excellence, strength, and beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jalila is derived from the Arabic root 'jalil', meaning 'great', 'excellent', or 'magnificent'. In the Quran, the term 'jalila' is used to describe a woman of great virtue and strength. In Islamic tradition, the name Jalila is associated with qualities of courage, wisdom, and compassion. It is a popular name among Muslims worldwide and is often given to girls born into families of high social status
